name: TeamMembers
description:
A team card: the member list with roles and presence, a seat count and an invite-by-email form - composed from Avatar, Badge, Button, Icon and Separator.

  TeamMembers(seats: 5, used: members.size, action: invitations_path) do
    TeamMemberList do
      members.each { |m| TeamMember(name: m.name, email: m.email, avatar: m.avatar_url, role: m.role, online: m.online?) }
    end
    TeamInvite()
  end

The invite form posts `email` to `action:` (Turbo submits it); answer with `turbo_stream.append list_id, AppicaUI::Blocks::TeamMember.new(email:, role: :invited)` - the seat count follows the rows and the form disables when every seat is taken. Without an `action:` it runs a demo that adds the invited row itself. Strings: team_members.locales.yml.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI::Blocks (e.g. `TeamMembers(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

TeamInvite.description: The invite form under a divider: an email field with a send button. Posts `name:` to the root's `action:`; disabled while every seat is taken.

TeamMember.description: One member: avatar with a presence dot, name, email and role badge. `role:` may be a translation key (:owner, :admin, :editor, :viewer, :invited) or any string; `online:` true/false shows the dot (nil hides it).

TeamMemberList.description: The member rows. Its id (the root's `list_id`) is the Turbo Stream target for new members.

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: The Appica homepage card. Invite an email to add a row; at five members the form locks.
examples.code:
phlex do
  TeamMembers(method:, invite:, **given(title:), seats: seats.to_i, used: MEMBERS.size, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    TeamMemberList do
      MEMBERS.each { |member| TeamMember(**member) }
    end
    TeamInvite(placeholder: "teammate@appica.dev")
  end
end

examples.name: All seats taken
examples.notes: When `used:` reaches `seats:` the Invite button and the form are disabled.
examples.code:
phlex do
  TeamMembers(seats: 4, used: 4, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    TeamMemberList { MEMBERS.each { |member| TeamMember(**member) } }
    TeamInvite()
  end
end

examples.name: Roles & pending invites
examples.notes:
Roles are translation keys (:owner, :admin, :editor, :viewer, :invited) or any string. Members
without an avatar show their initials; `online: nil` hides the presence dot.
examples.code:
phlex do
  TeamMembers(seats: 10, used: 5, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    TeamMemberList do
      TeamMember(**MEMBERS[0])
      TeamMember(name: "Priya Nair", email: "priya@appica.dev", role: :admin, online: true)
      TeamMember(name: "Jonas Berg", email: "jonas@appica.dev", avatar: "/avatars/05.png", role: "Billing", online: false)
      TeamMember(name: "Invited Teammate", email: "new.hire@appica.dev", role: :invited)
      TeamMember(name: "Chen Wei", email: "chen@appica.dev", avatar: "/avatars/08.png", role: :viewer)
    end
    TeamInvite()
  end
end

examples.name: Read-only
examples.notes: `invite: false` drops the Invite button; leave out TeamInvite and `seats:` for a plain list.
examples.code:
phlex do
  TeamMembers(invite: false, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    TeamMemberList { MEMBERS.first(3).each { |member| TeamMember(**member) } }
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes:
Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says: avatars lead from the right, roles and the send
button sit on the left.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      TeamMembers(seats: 5, used: 3, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
        TeamMemberList { MEMBERS.first(3).each { |member| TeamMember(**member) } }
        TeamInvite()
      end
    end
  end
end
